items.exampleEn: I looked up the bus times on my phone.
items.exampleZh: 我用手機查了公車時刻。

items.exampleEn: The boy ran away from the angry dog.
items.exampleZh: 那個男孩從那隻生氣的狗身邊逃開了。

items.exampleEn: Twenty students signed up for the school trip.
items.exampleZh: 有二十個學生報名參加校外旅行。

items.exampleEn: My grandpa takes care of the garden every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺每天早上照顧花園。

items.exampleEn: She took out her phone and called her mom.
items.exampleZh: 她拿出手機打電話給媽媽。

items.exampleEn: What are you two talking about?
Did you think about my idea?
items.exampleZh: 你考慮過我的點子了嗎？

items.sentenceEn: We often talk about our favorite movies at lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 我們午餐時常常聊我們最喜歡的電影。

items.audioEn: My sister signed up for a cooking class last week.
items.audioZh: 我姊姊上星期報名了一堂烹飪課。
items.questionZh: 說話者的姊姊上星期做了什麼？
options: She cooked a big dinner for us.

items.sentenceEn: Please take the dog out after dinner.
Let me think about it for a day.

items.stemEn: Who will ____ your dog while you are on vacation?
items.stemZh: 你去度假的時候，誰會照顧你的狗？

items.stemEn: Please ____ your books and turn to page ten.
items.stemZh: 請拿出你們的課本，翻到第十頁。

items.passageEn: Tina found a small cat near her school. It was hungry and very thin. When Tina came near, the cat didn't run away. She wanted to take care of it, but her parents were not sure. That night, the family talked about it at dinner. Her dad said, "We need to think about it." Tina looked up how to take care of cats on the internet. She also signed up for a free class at the pet shop. Finally, her parents said yes!
items.passageZh: Tina 在學校附近發現一隻小貓。牠很餓，也很瘦。Tina 走近時，那隻貓沒有逃跑。她想照顧牠，但她爸媽不太確定。那天晚上，一家人在晚餐時談論這件事。她爸爸說：「我們需要考慮一下。」Tina 上網查怎麼照顧貓，還在寵物店報名了一堂免費的課。最後，她爸媽答應了！

questions.questionZh: 晚餐時一家人談論什麼？
Tina 在寵物店做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我在考慮買一台新的腳踏車。
referenceEn: I'm thinking about buying a new bike.
I am thinking about buying a new bicycle.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 am thinking about 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 am considering buying、am thinking of buying 等）也算對
介系詞或 consider 後接動名詞（例如 about buying、of buying、considering buying 等）
「腳踏車」可寫，例如 bike、bicycle 等

items.promptZh: 如果你不知道這個字，就查一下字典。
referenceEn: If you don't know this word, look it up in the dictionary.
Look up this word in the dictionary if you don't know it.
Look this word up in the dictionary if you don't know it.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 look it up、look up this word 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 check it in the dictionary、find it in the dictionary 等）也算對
用片語時，受詞是代名詞放片語中間（look it up）；是名詞時可放後面或中間
if 子句可放句首或句尾；the dictionary、a dictionary、your dictionary 等都可以
